title: FABRIK solver for chains of any length
purpose: Reach a target with a chain of any number of joints and a fixed root by forward and backward reaching (FABRIK): segment lengths stay exact, a reachable target is met within tolerance, an unreachable one straightens the chain toward it, and applyFabrikChain poses a three.js bone or Object3D chain.

engine.name: webgl2_browser
engine.notes: solveFabrik, chainLengths and chainReach are pure ES2020; applyFabrikChain takes three.js as THREE (Object3D, Vector3, Quaternion). Only three.js 0.186.1 was run.

exports.name: solveFabrik
exports.signature: solveFabrik(joints, target, options = {}) -> {joints, iterations, error, reached, reachable}
exports.summary: Solve from the given pose with the root fixed; error is the end's remaining distance from the target.

exports.name: applyFabrikChain
exports.summary: Rotate a three.js chain (each object a descendant of the previous) so its last object reaches the target.

exports.name: chainLengths
exports.summary: Segment lengths; a zero-length segment is refused.

exports.name: chainReach
exports.summary: The end's reachable distances from the root: max(0, longest segment - the others) to the sum of all.

options.name: tolerance
options.meaning: End-to-target distance that counts as reached.

options.name: maxIterations
options.meaning: Cap on forward and backward passes.

limits: Positions only: no joint angle limits, no twist or roll control, no preferred bend direction, so the solved pose depends on the starting pose. Convergence slows near both ends of the reach: on 300 seeded random chains with targets kept a tenth of the range from either end, the median was 4 passes, 95 percent needed 17 or fewer, the slowest 80, and 3 were not within 1e-4 after the default 32. A target closer to the root than the chain can fold is reported unreachable and the chain folds toward it. applyFabrikChain rotates each object about its own origin by a shortest arc and assumes uniform scale. Only three.js 0.186.1 was run, in headless Chrome on SwiftShader WebGL 2.
technique_references: FABRIK: forward and backward reaching inverse kinematics
Reachable distance interval of a polygonal chain
Shortest-arc quaternion per segment, applied from the root outward
